messages:
marta: Heads up — after the kernel-hint tweak landed last night I'm seeing ~8% P50 regression on our 2k-seq stage runs. Repro locally and on stage. Looks like batches are smaller and KV hit rate dropped. cc @kevin @jun

kevin: Which change specifically? commit? do you have profiler output?

marta: commit 0f3a9e2 (kernel-hint: prefer short-seq fast path). Profiler snippet below, reproduced from stage run: 

```
batch_stats: { avg_batch_size: 3.2, median: 3, pct90: 6 }
before: avg_batch_size ~6.8
kv_cache: { hit_rate: 74%, misses_per_request: 1.9 }
before: kv_hit_rate ~92%
latency: p50 +8%, p95 +4%
```

kevin: wow kv hit rate drop is notable. Did the hint cause earlier eviction or change batching alignment so we no longer coalesce prefixes?

jun: my hunch: token-governor target got tighter when kernel path changed estimated token cost -> admission started trimming batches earlier. That lowers batch coalescing and increases KV misses because requests go to different batch windows. We should add hysteresis to token governor so small spikes don't immediately shrink admission.

sam: are we actually returning soft 429s or queuing longer? Observed client-side timeouts in some canaries.

marta: we flipped to soft-limit that returns soft-429 after token_budget exceeded for a window. Canaries show an uptick in soft_429_count.

leah: proposal for experiment (canary): 1) Apply token governor hysteresis (hold admission for 5s after a contraction), 2) lower token_budget_target from 0.9 -> 0.75 for canary, 3) prefer minimal batch_size floor = 4 to avoid microbatches, 4) enable KV-prefetch for warm prefixes. Config snippet: 

```
experiment: kernel-hint-hysteresis-1
token_budget_target: 0.75
hysteresis_seconds: 5
min_batch_size: 4
soft_429_behavior: queued_then_soft429
kv_prefetch: enabled
canary_pct: 5
```

kevin: good. Metrics to snapshot: p50/p95 latency, batch_size distribution, kv_hit_rate, soft_429_count, admitted_qps, kernel-path-chooser counts. Also capture a small sample of kv keys to ensure prefetch doesn't regress memory.

marta: I'll wire those dashboards and run the canary this afternoon. Running loadtest: 

```
./tools/loadtest --profile=2kseq --duration=15m --concurrency=120 --canary=on
```

ops-bot: deploy started: canary deploy kernel-hint-hysteresis-1 -> env=stage, deploy_id=deploy-2026-11-03-14-02

sam: if hysteresis helps we still need a rollback plan in case soft_429 spikes. Suggest auto-rollover: if soft_429_count_rate > 0.5% for 5m, revert on canary.

leah: added auto-rollback rule to experiment manifest.

marta: action items: (1) run canary and collect metrics (kevin + marta), (2) confirm kv_prefetch mem/eviction impact (jun), (3) verify auto-rollback triggers and playbook (sam). I'll post results in this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
